jobs.prompt: Create production game animation sprites of the original wolf-pelt male ranger in the supplied reference portrait. The portrait is identity/style reference only. Preserve wolf-head hood, dark brown leather, gray fur cloak, skull shoulder and belt ornaments, metal shin guards, quiver and wooden recurve bow, green magical arrow accent. Match a detailed old-school 2D isometric fantasy RPG sprite. One identical model, costume and body proportions throughout. No text, title, numbers, frames, grid lines, ground or shadow. TRUE transparent alpha background; do not draw a checkerboard. Full body and bow entirely visible in every cell, ample transparent margins. Perfect uniform grid with each character centered on the cell, identical scale and foot baseline; do not let any pixels cross cells. Rows are strictly: row 1 FRONT facing toward screen/down with face/chest visible; row 2 SIDE facing screen RIGHT; row 3 BACK facing screen UP away from viewer, showing wolf cloak and quiver, NO face or chest in this row. Isometric camera from slightly above. Make a 4 columns by 3 rows sprite sheet, exactly TWELVE full-body figures. Each row is one continuous four-frame walking cycle: left contact, passing, right contact, passing. Feet genuinely alternate, arms and cloak respond naturally, lowered bow held in hand, head/body stay at constant height with slight natural movement. No attack/particles. Landscape sheet 1536x1024 if possible, precisely uniform cells. Front row walks down toward viewer, side row walks RIGHT, back row walks UP away from viewer.
